messages.author: 4fd3bbd32ffafb00
messages.subject: Small Area Estimation.
parts:
Hello INLA People,
Does anyone have an example INLA script for Small Area Estimation with sampling weights.i.e as proposed
by Cici Chen et al here:  https://www.stat.washington.edu/research/reports/2011/tr583.pdf

Your inputs are appreciated .

messages.author: b453c29749de564d
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Small Area Estimation.
parts:
On Mon, 2016-03-21 at 04:44 -0700, lukas wrote:
> Hello INLA People,
> Does anyone have an example INLA script for Small Area Estimation
> with sampling weights.i.e as proposed
> by Cici Chen et al here:  https://www.stat.washington.edu/research/re
> ports/2011/tr583.pdf

Hi,

Model1  is the betabinomial: see inla.doc("betabinomial")

Model2  is  y ~ 1 + f(idx, model="iid")

Model3 is  y ~ 1 + f(idx, model="bym")  (or better: use bym2)


or contact Cici.C:

https://vivo.brown.edu/display/cxbauer


Best
H
